Per the project memory, any Growth engineer can approve it. As of 2026-09-01 the notifier belongs to the Growth team, because Dana Okafor moved to Platform. Template and copy changes are signed off in #growth-eng.

I haven't checked this against a CODEOWNERS file or anything else in the repo. The memory is a month old, so confirm ownership in #growth-eng if it matters.

When you edit the wording, there are two things to keep in mind:
- Templates live in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Each one has a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, with the same variables. Change both, or the plain-text version will drift from the HTML one.
- Template variables are snake_case.
